requirements.request: Analyze China pet industry in2019–2023 by pet type, factors, and forecast2024–2026
requirements.deliverable: Cat/dog trends, cautiously scoped drivers and forecasts with validation limits
requirements.acceptance: Original pet-count units, selected forecast source, chronological errors; no causal inference from fivepoints

requirements.request: Analyze overseas pet industry bytype and forecast global pet-food demand2024–2026
requirements.deliverable: Named markets and conditional worldwide quantities, explicit production-to-consumption assumptions
requirements.acceptance: No three-market-to-world transfer or production-as-consumption claim; uncalibrated global growth remains unverified

requirements.request: With policy unchanged, link global demand to China pet-food industry and forecast production/export value2024–2026
requirements.deliverable: Monetary baselines plus conditional quantity-price-share-FX/valuation bridge
requirements.acceptance: No mixed currencies/tonnes, no inferred matched valuation without evidence; scope assumptions and inspect bridge envelope

requirements.request: Quantify tariff/policy impacts and recommend sustainable China pet-food strategies
requirements.deliverable: Coupled prices/demand/profit; analytic absorption choice, capacity/cost thresholds and validation needs
requirements.acceptance: Consistent buyer/producer prices, original tariffs not invented, policy feasibility conditional rather than empirically optimal strategy
